Rune reasoning: Viktor — Augmented Hextech Ray: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: E5 beam230+0.5AP plus upgraded aftershock140+0.8AP equals370+1.3AP if both hit; AP/MR penetration strengthen both. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void provides40% MR penetration; Shadowfla Deathfire Touch: Burn is a separate packet with real refresh/ramp rules, not extra native ticks. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Haste: Cooldown utility; no extra casts inside a one-cast benchmark. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

builds.name: Siphon Power: discharge AD/AP crossover

builds.goal: Investigate high Siphon Power empowered discharge attack output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 discharge helper is 120 + 0.5 AP + total AD magic damage. The earlier missile is a separate 120 + 0.4 AP packet. Lich Bane is a separate Spellblade event, not a multiplier on the entire helper.

builds.name: Arcane Storm: four earned extensions
builds.summary: Explore high one Arcane Storm on a survivor with four earned extensions output with explicit finite conditions; compare item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore high one Arcane Storm on a survivor with four earned extensions output with explicit finite conditions; compare item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R begins with 100/175/250 + 0.50 AP and periodic helper 65/105/145 + 0.35 AP per second. The base duration is 6.5 seconds. Upgraded R adds three seconds when a champion it damaged dies, up to six growths; four actual other-enemy deaths can nominally extend this one storm to 18.5 seconds.
